text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I came up with a lot of proverbs today, so I'd better write them down in my notebook before I forget any!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I sure have a lot of Chiyonotes now, though. Maybe I should separate the proverbs out into their own section.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Wow, this brings back memories. "You'll only sell yourself short if you sell yourself to shortcuts."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "You only have three minutes on the turf." "Set the table at breakneck speed." Ahh, I'd almost forgotten these. My early proverbs are so spirited.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Hoard all the crispy rice crackers you can"… This one could use some work.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If I rework it with my current expertise, I'd write it as… "When it comes to rice crackers, it's crunch or be crunched!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: This might be more work than I anticipated…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But that proverb turned out so much better, maybe I should try reworking some of my other ones too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just like that, Sakura Chiyono O loses herself in her notebook, forgetting the time and missing training completely.
